reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD has its own workbench tool bars and enables tools from its BarCtx state; there is no Matrix Top 11 catalogue.
Selection is QymCAD document-model state, not an OM9 ObjectId set with document stamps.
The curve edits are sketch-entity operations tied to QymCAD's Project/Id model.

rationale: QymCAD edits sketch entities by Id through its sketch model. The portable pole/Greville grip record is OM9's, built on curve_ops.
not_reused: QymCAD BarCtx/Hand UI state and its sketch Id document model.
QymCAD native/OCCT adapters; the Top 11 are host command adapters over OM9's document.
l3_scope: Edit Points On and Control Points On show grips for curves and surfaces and let the user drag them. Control grips cover line/NURBS points, circle centre/quadrants, every polycurve segment and a surface control net; edit grips cover line/NURBS/circle/polycurve points and an OM9-specific surface edit grid: the surface point at each Greville pair. Dragging a surface edit point moves its corresponding pole by the drag divided by that pole's rational basis influence, so the point reaches the target without changing knots, weights, degree or the periodic/reversed record. F10 is wired to PointsOn; Cancel/Esc clears the display.
